facts.fact: UNICEF Comores says e-Msomo, the school management platform, allows online entry of pupils' grades, automatic report cards and a unique identifier for each pupil.
UNICEF Comores says a pilot phase of e-Msomo is currently deployed in several public schools, with national extension in prospect.
UNICEF Comores says it gives strategic and financial support to e-Msomo, led by the Ministry of National Education with ANADEN handling technical development and deployment.
UNICEF Comores says the Ministry of National Education initiated and leads e-Msomo, with ANADEN in charge of its technical development.

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education with ANADEN
